reason: Implements GTM v2 account/container/workspace inspection, tag/trigger/variable CRUD, saved version creation and publishing alongside GA4 tools.
exposure: All 40 decorated tools register unconditionally; clients and credentials are initialized lazily when handlers run.
limitations: Offline FastMCP registration executes only source function definitions; original third-party Google imports and authenticated handlers were not executed. Schemas reflect the installed MCP/Pydantic versions; upstream dependency ranges are not locked.
GTM list handlers return one API response and do not follow pagination tokens. JSON resource parameters are strings, with no nested GTM resource validation in the public schema.
